detailed_description:
The video uses cinematic semi-realistic 3D rendering with soft volumetric skin shading, fine moving hair strands, readable woven fabric, wet metal and physically coherent contact shadows. Characters, ship and storm water share cold gray-blue illumination, with wind-driven spray and cloth motion tied to the main action.

[Shot 1] In an extreme wide shot, the rusted giant ocean liner from <Subject 3> cuts diagonally through the frame, its dark hull, two red-and-black funnels, broken rigging and steeply inclined deck looming over a churning field of gray-blue waves and shattered boat wreckage. High on the slanted deck near the right rail, Madison <Subject 2> wears her light pink piped pajamas and beige slippers as she presses uphill toward Ava <Subject 1>; Ava <Subject 1> wears her beige tank top, matching belted trousers and gray sneakers and backs away with her weight on the tilted metal. Below the rail, only a tall dark dorsal fin belonging to the giant shark <Subject 4> glides through a foamy trough, matching its blue-gray dorsal coloring and triangular fin. The camera performs one slow continuous push along the slanted deck toward the rail, ending with a slight downward tilt toward the circling fin. Enormous waves hammer the hull, metal twists with deep groans, and storm wind howls through the rigging; there is no dialogue.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close, static interaction shot beside the rail. Madison <Subject 2> stands left-center with both hands twisted into the front of Ava <Subject 1>'s tank top, her wavy brown hair blowing around a cold smile; Ava <Subject 1> is pinned at the right edge of the frame, the rail behind her shoulders and her feet braced on the slope. Madison <Subject 2> (S2) says in a cold, taunting voice, with her mouth synchronized to her en-US delivery, <d>[English] Big sister, why don't you go down and feed the fish?</d> The cloth pulls taut with a rough fabric-straining sound, Madison gives a low cold chuckle, and the ship creaks violently around them. On the shove, the camera makes one short sharp forward rush as Madison <Subject 2> releases the grip and drives both palms hard into Ava <Subject 1>'s shoulders. The push sends Ava backward; her shoulders meet the rail, her upper body tips beyond it, and her hair and loose clothing snap with the sudden force.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a steep high-angle full shot and immediately follows the fall. Ava <Subject 1> loses her balance completely and tumbles backward over the ship rail, one arm thrown upward while the other crosses her chest, her gray sneakers leaving the deck as she drops toward the sea. Ava <Subject 1> (S1) makes a sharp wordless intake of breath as the fall begins. Beneath her, the giant shark <Subject 4> rises from a collapsing wave, water streaming from its scarred blue-gray back and pale underside, its pectoral fins spread and its head lifting until the massive jaws open to show rows of triangular teeth. The camera descends rapidly with Ava <Subject 1>, keeping her centered above the shark while the storm-lit liner rail slides out of the upper frame and spray fills the background. Rushing wind surrounds Ava during the fall, and the thunder of waves surges abruptly louder as the open mouth rises toward her; the clip ends before contact.

overall_soundscape:
The soundscape is dominated by storm wind, waves battering the hull, and continuous deep metal groaning from the listing ship. Cloth strains during Madison's grip, a short forward whoosh accompanies the shove, and Ava's sharp breath leads into rushing fall wind. The final descent is filled with wind, spray and rapidly approaching surf around the shark.
